blocklist.name: URL Blocklist
blocklist.description: Blocks connection to the sites listed in the filter list, defaults offer a safe and efficient set.

userscripts.name: Userscripts
userscripts.description: it really just loads files from a folder, userscripts is an overstatement

obsCapturePlugin.name: OBS Capture Plugin
obsCapturePlugin.description: Install the Glorp Capture source into OBS. This changes the OBS installation and may require administrator permission.

clearCache.name: Clear Cache & Storage
clearCache.description: Clears local storage, browser cache, and web data for the client
clearCache.buttonAction: if(confirm('Are you sure you want to clear cache and local storage?')) { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); window.chrome.webview.postMessage('clear-cache'); }

rampBoost.name: Ramp Boosting
rampBoost.description: a much less powerful version of the regular rampboosting but way easier to hit consistently (and more useful in regular matches i'd say); turn off if you plan on using external software

hsSound.name: Always Play HS Sound on Kill

hpEnemyCounter.name: Hardpoint Enemy counter
hpEnemyCounter.description: Shows the number of enemies present on the hardpoint during competitive matches

renderStats.name: Render Fps
renderStats.description: makes fps counter show how many times an image is presented to the screen, not how many times the game loop runs

betterChat.name: Better Chat
betterChat.description: Groups the team and all chat into a single channel; press tab to switch where you send yours

cleanUI.name: Cleaner Menu
cleanUI.description: Remove some of the unnecessary DOM elements

realPing.name: Real Ping™️
realPing.description: Show real network latency™️! pings the lobby every few seconds to get a value;

rawInput.name: Raw Input (!)
rawInput.description: Lower latency, greater precision, fixes mouse flicks

fpsLimit.name: FPS Limit
fpsLimit.description: Limits displayed frames. Set to 0 for unlimited.

throttle.name: CPU Throttling
throttle.description: Throttle CPU, value is the multiplier (2 is 50%), ONLY USE IF YOUR GAME EXPERIENCES INSTABILITY

inMenuThrottle.name: CPU Throttling in Menu
inMenuThrottle.description: Throttle CPU in menus, fixes an issue related to render FPS in menus

webviewPriority.name: Webview Priority
webviewPriority.description: Higher priority yields slightly better performance but might cause instabilities

hardFlip.name: Hook DXGI Swapchain Creation
hardFlip.description: Reduce latency by tweaking swapchain settings; keep on unless experiencing crashes
